tasks.CalculateCurrentQuantities: Calculate the current quantities of sand and clay in the mixture.
tasks.DetermineRequiredChange: Determine how much of the mixture needs to be changed to make equal amounts of sand and clay.
tasks.FormulateEquation: Formulate an equation based on the required change.
tasks.SolveForX: Solve for x, which represents the amount of mixture to be removed and replaced with pure sand.
